text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Summer Training Camp" finally begins today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: During this summer camp, I'll build up overwhelming strength that won't be swayed by any jinxes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To build overwhelming strength, we plan to focus heavily on fundamental training during the summer camp. First and foremost, building a solid physical foundation is crucial.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, building enough stamina to complete the Kikuka Sho's 3,000 meters will be our primary challenge.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, let's hurry up and go to the room!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Geez, Kita-chan is getting so worked up.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Because it's the beach! I'm so pumped! Time to train like crazy again this year~!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, Dia-chan's totally into it too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm all fired up too.
Because I definitely want to win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the Kikuka Sho just like Kita-chan did...
break the Satono jinx...
and become someone truly worthy of being Kita-chan's rival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan...!
You're right! So that the two of us can run together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their spirited rallying cries echo through the summer sky.
—This is shaping up to be an intense summer training camp!
